name: Default-state confusion: deployment override detected

input.title: Fresh install ships with default admin/admin credentials
input.summary: DEFAULT admin/admin in fresh-install image. BUT actual production deployments override via secrets.yaml at first boot — production default is rotated. Fresh-install default is fine because the image is meant for dev only and is documented as such.
input.root_cause: Default is intentional for dev, overridden in prod

rationale: Per Spec §18: deployment override detected; admin must override to ship insecurely. disposition_reason=admin_action_required (mapped to admin_misconfiguration when explicitly enabled).
